definitions.name: Fan

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: Yellow wire drives a single-direction motor through GPIO/PWM. Official driver initializes 250Hz and maps requested speed 1..100 to duty 70..1023 (zero disables). This is control duty, not a calibrated RPM model.
gaps: The verified product text does not identify the motor-driver transistor/IC; no L9110 identity is guessed.
No-load 8800RPM is a product specification, not a linear PWM-to-RPM transfer function.
